Predicates:
WrestlingStable(x) ::: x is a professional wrestling stable.
Leads(x, y) ::: x leads y.
Member(x, y) ::: x is a member of y.
HasFeud(x, y) ::: x has a feud with y.
Premises:
WrestlingStable(diamondMine) ::: Diamond Mine is a professional wrestling stable, formed in WWE.
Leads(roderickStrong, diamondMine) ::: Roderick Strong leads Diamond Mine.
Member(creedBrothers, diamondMine) ::: Diamond Mine includes the Creed Brothers, and Ivy Nile.
Member(ivyNile, diamondMine) ::: Diamond Mine includes the Creed Brothers, and Ivy Nile.
HasFeud(imperium, diamondMine) ::: Imperium has a feud with Diamond Mine.
Conclusion:
Leads(roderickStrong, creedBrothers) ::: Roderick strong leads the Creed Brothers.
